source.name: SportsDataverse / fastRhockey NHL schedules (NHL upstream)
source.attribution: SportsDataverse / fastRhockey authors; source-derived statistics normalized by TONATI LAB. No league or provider endorsement.

processing.limitations: Regular-season final scores only, including overtime and the official shootout deciding goal. Wins and losses here are game outcomes, not NHL standings points; overtime losses are not separated. Preseason and playoffs are excluded. The community dataset can lag or revise results. No lineups, goalie availability, injuries, expected goals or model probability is supplied.
